I would like to know about Dream-Interpretation (Tabeer). I'm heard that Dreams are of 3 types, one from Allah, one from Shaitan and another with no explanation. Suppose, I saw a dream and asked three different Scholars/Mufti for the Interpretation/Tabeer of my dream and all of them interpreted my dreams with different meanings, so what interpretation should I consider? the interpretation given by the first Scholar or the interpretation which seems to be more positive/best to me? 3265 views Q. Assalam o Alaikum Warahmatullahe Wabarakatuhu Mofti sahb, I am in circumstances where I have to take some very important decision. The situation is that I am living in Dubai, UAE with my family. I got married in 2007 and Allah Blessed me with a daughter this year. My wife, daughter and mother all live with me here in Dubai. My father was died long back and I am taking care of my mother. As you know, due to increasing inflation it is very difficult to save some money. I could not save any single dirham for last two years since when I came here in dubai.and also sometime a satuation come that it becomes very difficylt to pass the month in my earning So I am thinking whether to keep my family here with me and keep living without saving any money and just trust on Allah that situation will get better or if I send my family back home (Pakistan), I can save reasonable amount every month. So before making the final decision, I decided to do ''Istikhara'' as sunnah. Yesterday night, I abolute and offered two nawaffil and then recite dua for correct guidance from Allah SWT and then slept without talking to anybody. I saw a dream that I want you to give me ''tabeer'' for. I saw that I am standing by a closed grave which is made of white marble (and I felt in dream that this is my own grave). I am dusting the grave and I am saying to my wife with so much grief that how would you live without me (meaning that when I will go into the grave). That''s it. I don''t know whether this dream is meaningful or not. Or it has any connection with ''Istikhara'' but I simply request you to please guide me on this. Jazakumullaho khair. 1489 views Q. Asalamualaykum Mufti Sahab, I have 2 sons aged 3.5 and 8 yrs. About 2-3 months ago, my wife saw a dream that she is hitting our elder son with a thick stick like object on the head. She is crying and does not want to hit him but she is continuing to hit him. Due to some reason, she is unable to stop hitting him. About a week ago I saw a similar dream about my elder son with the difference that I am hitting him all over his body with my hand. I am trying to him even harder but my strikes are not turning out to be very hard despite my attempts. He is a very beautiful and obedient child. He does tend to be very mischievous at times, but it is easily controlled by us. We are very worried about these strange dreams. Please interpret this dreams for us. Jazakallahukhaire. 1519 views Q. answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 14396 Country: India Title: ASAK, I see fitna of Dajjal very oftenly in my dreams. Could you please let me know what does this signifies and what should I do inorder to prevent myself from it. I do remember the first time when I saw that dream about Dajjal , when I woke up I was so much scared and my body was shivering. Most of the time I see that I am running away from people of Dajjal. I don't remember the exact dream but I see it very frequntly. Question: ASAK, I see fitna of Dajjal very oftenly in my dreams. Could you please let me know what does this signifies and what should I do inorder to prevent myself from it. I do remember the first time when I saw that dream about Dajjal , when I woke up I was so much scared and my body was shivering. Most of the time I see that I am running away from people of Dajjal. I don't remember the exact dream but I see it very frequntly. Answer ID: 14396 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 2141/1006=D/1430) It indicates to the fitnah (mischief, evils) occurring near Qiyamah. In present condition, there are such evils which require firmness on iman and steadiness on good deeds. The aforementioned dream indicates to the same and it serves as warning for being firm on iman and good deeds. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
